3.text:
Testifiers:

Vance Oakstadd, Director of Talent Acquisition, Cirrus Aircraft

Rachel Johnson, President, Area Partnership for Economic Development
Senator Rest moved that S.F. 2365, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 4918: Senator Putnam: City of St. Cloud refundable sales and use tax exemption for
construction projects in a redevelopment district provision and appropriation.

Senator Putman moved the A-2 amendment. The motion prevailed and the A-2 amendment was
adopted.

Testifier:
Dave Kleis, Mayor, St. Cloud

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 4918, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 4803: Senator Weber: Various independent school district construction projects sales
and use tax exemption provision and appropriation.

Senator Weber moved the A-5 amendment.
Senator Weber moved an oral amendment to the A-5 amendment: line 1.12: delete "September”
and insert "January" and delete "2025" and insert "2026". The motion prevailed and the A-5

amendment, as amended, was adopted.

Testifier:
Todd Holthaus, Superintendent, Hills-Beaver Creek Schools

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 4803, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 3228: Senator Mathews: Becker Public School District refundable construction
exemption provision.

Sen. Klein moved an oral amendment: on lines 1.14 and 1.22: delete "2025" and insert "2026"
and on line 1.18: delete "2023" and insert "2024". The motion prevailed and the oral amendment
was adopted.

Testifier:
Jeremy Schmidt, Superintendent, Becker School District

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 3228, as amended, be laid over.
The gavel was transferred to Senator Klein.

S.F. 4591: Senator Port: Construction material used in the city of Burnsville refundable
sales and use tax exemption authorization.

Senator Rest presented the bill for Senator Port.

Senator Rest moved the A-1 amendment. The motion prevailed and the A-1 amendment was
adopted.

Testifier:
Elizabeth Kautz, Mayor, Burnsville

Senator Klein moved that S.F. 4591, as amended, be laid over.

The meeting was adjourned at 10:54am.
